threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the overground is a train and not a rolling rave. Good luck finding a seat during peak hours!
Caught the 35 to Streatham last night, sat next to a guy in a full tuxedo who was holding a pizza box. Full-on wedding vibes at 2 AM, but he was just headed home.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a random street artist painting a mural of an old lady feeding pigeons while sipping a Berliner Kindl at Kottbusser Tor.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a Kebab stand that serves currywurst on a bed of fries, topped with peanut sauce. It’s weirdly delicious.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their instinct to avoid the BART Civic Center stop. Loud bangs and smoke? Nah, we just take the bus or walk.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tattered suit serenading the bus stop with a trumpet. Bus rolled up, and it was clear no one wanted to interrupt the show.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals hang out in Plaça del Sol. The real vibe is at the little bars down side streets, where the conversations flow and the prices don't bite.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion over whether to queue or just push past at the Mercat de Gràcia. The locals have their unspoken rules.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still walk across the street for a bus when the 38 is five minutes away. Locals just chill on the curb, saving their steps.
Caught a guy trying to sell a used umbrella on the 63 last night. Said it was lucky if you opened it at midnight. Only in Peckham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid on a bike, juggling apples while his dog chased a pigeon—only in Neukölln, right? Just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you hop from a techno club to an authentic Turkish kebab stand at 5 AM and find it bustling with life, no matter the hour.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know you can run a red light at 16th and Mission during rush hour and still make it to the taco truck before the next bus comes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that was literally held up by a street performer doing magic tricks. Everyone was more entertained than upset about the delay.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are all about sipping cervezas, but locals know they're actually the best spots for spontaneous flamenco under the stars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they order 'café con leche'—too timid, no idea about the local 'café amb llet' vibe.
